run_optimize: run nonlinear least-squares optimization on system identification residuals with scipy or mujoco backend
calculate_intervals: calculate parameter confidence intervals from the Jacobian at the optimization optimum
dispatch_optimizer: dispatch to scipy or mujoco least-squares optimizer backend for system identification
run_scipy_least_squares: run scipy least_squares with optional MuJoCo finite-difference Jacobian for parameter optimization
run_mujoco_least_squares: run MuJoCo native least_squares optimizer for system identification parameter fitting
